domains.name: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization

tasks.name: Implement and manage security and compliance tools and policies.
Implement strategies to protect data and infrastructure.

concepts.name: AWS Identity and Access Management
concepts.description: Controls authentication and authorization for AWS identities and resources.

concepts.name: IAM roles
concepts.description: Provide temporary credentials and permissions to trusted principals or AWS workloads.

concepts.name: Resource-based policies
concepts.description: Attach permissions directly to supported resources and can grant cross-account access.

concepts.name: IAM policy conditions
concepts.description: Restrict when a policy statement applies based on request context.

concepts.name: Multi-factor authentication
concepts.description: Adds an additional authentication factor to protect sign-in and sensitive operations.

concepts.name: IAM Access Analyzer
concepts.description: Analyzes resource and identity access, including external access and policy validation.

concepts.name: IAM policy simulator
concepts.description: Evaluates how identity policies and related policy types affect simulated API requests.

concepts.name: AWS CloudTrail
concepts.description: Records AWS API and console activity for auditing and investigation.

concepts.name: AWS Organizations
concepts.description: Centrally manages multiple AWS accounts in an organization.

concepts.name: Service control policies
concepts.description: Set permission guardrails for accounts or organizational units; they do not grant permissions.

concepts.name: IAM Identity Center
concepts.description: Centrally manages workforce access to multiple AWS accounts and applications.

concepts.name: Trusted Advisor security checks
concepts.description: Identifies selected security risks and recommended actions.

concepts.name: AWS Config
concepts.description: Records resource configuration and evaluates resources against configuration rules.

concepts.name: AWS Config conformance packs
concepts.description: Bundle Config rules and remediation actions for a common compliance framework.

concepts.name: Data classification
concepts.description: Categorizes data by sensitivity and handling requirements.

concepts.name: AWS Key Management Service
concepts.description: Creates and controls cryptographic keys used by AWS services and applications.

concepts.name: KMS key authorization
concepts.description: KMS key policies, IAM policies, and grants determine who can use a KMS key.

concepts.name: AWS Certificate Manager
concepts.description: Provisions and manages TLS certificates for supported AWS services.

concepts.name: AWS Secrets Manager
concepts.description: Stores, retrieves, and can rotate application secrets.

concepts.name: Amazon Macie
concepts.description: Discovers and helps classify sensitive data stored in Amazon S3.

concepts.name: AWS Security Hub
concepts.description: Aggregates and normalizes security findings and security posture information.

concepts.name: Amazon GuardDuty
concepts.description: Detects suspicious and potentially malicious activity using AWS data sources.

concepts.name: Amazon Inspector
concepts.description: Continuously scans supported workloads for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.

concepts.name: AWS Security Agent
concepts.description: Provides application-security reviews and security findings, including code review and penetration testing capabilities.

concepts.name: Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store
concepts.description: AWS Secrets Manager stores secrets and supports secret-lifecycle features such as managed rotation integrations. Systems Manager Parameter Store stores hierarchical configuration values and can also store encrypted parameters.

concepts.name: AWS Control Tower
concepts.description: Service for setting up and governing a prescriptive multi-account landing zone.

concepts.name: Federated identity
concepts.description: Use of an external identity source to obtain temporary AWS access.

concepts.name: IAM permissions boundary
concepts.description: Policy that sets the maximum permissions an IAM principal can receive.

questions.prompt: Put the simplified envelope-encryption flow in order.

items.label: Obtain a data key protected by a KMS key
Use the plaintext data key to encrypt the application data
Store the ciphertext with the encrypted data key, then remove the plaintext data key from memory
Later, ask KMS to decrypt the encrypted data key
Use the recovered plaintext data key to decrypt the application data

questions.explanation: Envelope encryption uses a data key for the payload and a KMS key to protect that data key. Store the encrypted payload with the encrypted copy of the data key and discard the plaintext data key after use. For decryption, KMS first recovers the data key, then that plaintext data key decrypts the payload.
